title: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst
summary: Generate image with GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst
description: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst — the most capable GPT Image model, built for premium visual work and precise, instruction-scoped edits that keep subject, composition and background intact. Text-to-image and image editing with up to 9 reference images, 1K/2K/4K output and five quality tiers. Billing: per output image, quality × resolution — at 1K: low 30, medium 40, high 80, xhigh 130, max 250 credits; 2K doubles and 4K triples those. Reference images: the first is free, each additional one adds 5 credits. Default quality medium (40 credits at 1K).

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

quality.description: Rendering quality. Per image at 1K: low 30, medium 40, high 80, xhigh 130, max 250 credits (scaled by resolution).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. The first reference is free; each additional one adds 5 credits per generated image.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. 2K bills 2× and 4K 3× the 1K price of the chosen quality.
